posts.headline:
ISRO KA GSLV-F17 MISSION ITIHAASIK KAAMYAB:
EOS-05 SATELLITE ORBIT MEIN, SPACE TECH TRANSFER!
posts.subheadline: Sriharikota se launch huye heavy GSLV ne poora kiya orbital maneuver. IN-SPACe ke tehat private aerospace giants ko rocket technology transfer ki tezi.
posts.highlighted_fact: GSLV-F17 EOS-05 Success | Space Tech Transfer
posts.caption: 🚀 Space Milestone: ISRO ke GSLV-F17 ne EOS-05 satellite ko orbit me kiya sthapit, space privatisation par bada roadmap! 🇮🇳🛰️ Bharat ki space agency ISRO ne ek aur itihaasik kamyabi hasil ki hai! Sriharikota ke Satish Dhawan Space Centre se launch huye heavy GSLV-F17 rocket ne advanced Earth Observation Satellite EOS-05 ko geostationary orbit me successfully inject kar diya hai. Sath hi IN-SPACe ke tehat Bharat ke private aerospace sector ko rocket manufacturing transfer karne par ahem policy updates samne aayi hain jisse L&T, Godrej aur Skyroot jaise Indian aerospace giants ko massive boost milega! Kya Bharat ka private space sector SpaceX ko takkar de payega? Apni rai comment karein! 👇💬 Source: ISRO & Department of Space #isro #gslvf17 #eos05 #spaceindia #indianews

posts.headline:
ZERODHA KA DALAL STREET PAR BADA DHAMAKA:
SEBI SE MILA CATEGORY-1 INVESTMENT BANKING LICENSE!
posts.subheadline: Kamath brothers ab manage karenge mega corporate IPOs aur underwriting. Traditional foreign aur private investment banks ko mili direct chunauti.
posts.highlighted_fact: SEBI Cat-1 Merchant License | IPO Management
posts.caption: 📈 Dalal Street Revolution: Zerodha ne li investment banking me entry, SEBI se mila Category-1 Merchant Banking license! 💼💸 Desh ke sabse bade discount retail broker Zerodha ne Indian financial market me naya tehelka macha diya hai! SEBI ne Zerodha Corporate Advisors ko Category-1 Merchant Banking license grant kar diya hai, jiske tehat ab Nithin aur Nikhil Kamath ki company corporate IPOs, QIPs, debt issuances aur underwriting direct handle karegi. Wall Street aur traditional Indian investment banks ke liye yeh direct challenge banne ja raha hai kyunki Zerodha apne massive tech infrastructure se IPO management ko low-cost aur automated banane ki taiyari me hai! Kya Zerodha IPO investment banking market ko poori tarah badal dega? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: SEBI & Financial Express #zerodha #dalalstreet #stockmarketindia #ipo #fintechnews

posts.headline:
CBI KA ESSEL GROUP PAR SHIKANJA:
SUBHASH CHANDRA PAR RS. 1,322 CRORE FRAUD KA CASE DARJ!
posts.subheadline: LIC Housing Finance loan diversion me CBI ne darj ki criminal FIR. Mumbai aur Delhi me financial investigation tez, public funds ghotala.
posts.highlighted_fact: Rs. 1,322 Cr Fraud FIR | LIC Housing Finance Scam
posts.caption: ⚖️ High-Profile Financial Bust: CBI ne Essel Group founder Subhash Chandra par darj kiya RS. 1,322 Crore fraud ka case! 🚨📄 Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) ne media giant Zee/Essel Group ke promoter Subhash Chandra aur unke associates ke khilaf ek bada criminal case darj kar liya hai! Allegations hain ki LIC Housing Finance Ltd se liye gaye ₹1,322 Crore ke loan funds ko doosri shell companies me illegally divert kiya gaya aur public sector financial institution ko bhari chot pahunchayi gayi. CBI ne Mumbai aur Delhi me document verification aur investigation tez kar di hai! Corporate loan defaults aur banking fraud par kadi karwai par aapki kya rai hai? Comment karein! 👇💬 Source: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) #cbinews #subhashchandra #esselgroup #bankingfraud #breakingnews
